jd_insights.summary: Meta seeks entry-level software engineers to join its Bangalore team, focusing on building and improving global-scale products (e.g., mobile/web apps, AR/VR). The role involves solving complex technical challenges, writing high-quality code, and collaborating on projects that connect billions of users while adhering to Meta’s development standards and performance philosophy.

knowledge_requirements.text: Develop a strong understanding of relevant product area, codebase, and/or systems
Master Meta’s development standards from developing to releasing code in order to take on tasks and projects with increasing levels of complexity

knowledge_mentions.excerpt: designed scalable microservices architectures with docker/kubernetes orchestration
optimized ml inference services for production throughput (batching, model tuning)
implemented concurrency control in high-frequency order matching systems (java + redis)
built end-to-end ocr pipelines combining tesseract with custom nlp post-processing
architected ci/cd workflows integrating jenkins, aws codepipeline, and git
